mappings.reason: Monetary fineness is a use of calibrated compositional assay, not a new measurement mechanism. Payment inspection can consume this evidence.
Paid conditional capacity reservation is covered by contingent supply, with optional exercise represented by the separately authored option contract.
Measured service acceptance specializes the existing conditional escrow release mechanism; measurement capability remains a real operating requirement.
Evidence-dependent continuation, redirection or stopping of research belongs to existing reversible project optioning, not an additional research-prefixed discovery.

Work/pay disputes apply the existing voluntary mediation mechanism; the authored proposal introduces no separate dispute-resolution method. Application evidence and paid mediator time remain requirements. Mediation does not require binding arbitration.

scope_distinctions.distinction: Permission to use, transmission of practical method and demonstrated reproducibility are separate mechanisms; none automatically grants the others.
Accepted payment material differs from a valuation unit; debts can be denominated in a unit without being discharged in that material.
These change information revelation, buyer/seller roles or the allocation problem; none is presented as universally optimal.
General finite pooling, shipping-specific insured exposure and evidence-based claim adjustment are distinct. Earlier specialized marine coverage need not wait for later general formalization.
